system.description:
You become [Riding: Riding Horse]. Also, during the [Riding: Riding Horse] state, you can use the EX Power <<Horse Trot>>. [SR2] In addition, the EX Power <<Horse Kick>> becomes available. [CR10] You can use 《Wartrot》 instead of 《Horstrot》.

A feat that shows that you have excellent riding skills and a horse of your own. Of course, fighting on horseback is also a skill.
